narrative.overview: Current release scope is documented in docs/RELEASE-SCOPE.md. One-column viewport hero: Dari nol, sampai bisa. A 60-lesson curriculum starts from web foundations; practice remains in learning pages. Shadow-free dot-grid surfaces, matching card tone, neutral links, black GitHub control, local Manrope and SVG code mark. Circular history navigation replaces breadcrumbs.
keyCharacteristics: Viewport-sized single-column hero with no second card or editor.
60 ordered lessons and 48 frontend exercises, progress retained across old URLs.
Matching neutral card/background tone, no shadows, local fonts and SVG identity.

rules.name: The Theme Pair Rule
rules.body: Apply surface, text, dot, and shadow colors from the same active theme.

dos: Do preserve theme-aware text, focus indicators, and native editing controls.
Do keep the dot grid behind transparent hero space and the editor visibly functional.
Do preserve reduced-motion, high-contrast, safe-area, and mobile focus behavior.
donts: Don't restore the historical yellow/red palette or photo hero as the current direction.
Don't use shadows as the only focus or high-contrast boundary.
Don't introduce an external font or execution API for this system.
